entries.name: viem
entries.reason: Production v1.18.39 runs viem 2.57.20, so locking it avoids a downgrade to 2.57.19. It ages past 3 days at 2026-11-18T08:19:05Z.

entries.name: serve
entries.reason: app/web/runtime/package.json locks serve, which the web image runs as /app/runtime/node_modules/.bin/serve in place of a global install.

entries.name: bitcoinjs-lib
entries.reason: app/api overrides bitcoinjs-lib to 6.1.8 because its parents pin the vulnerable 6.1.7 exactly (invoices@5.0.2 and psbt@5.0.0), and ln-service's fixed releases (59+) require Node 22.

entries.name: @grpc/grpc-js
entries.reason: app/api overrides @grpc/grpc-js to 1.14.7 because its parent pins the vulnerable 1.14.3 exactly (lightning@11.1.0), and ln-service's fixed releases (59+) require Node 22.
